Wiring all three into one system

takeaways: Teams meeting extensibility rests on three interoperable pieces: custom meeting apps, in-meeting side panels and Microsoft Graph meeting lifecycle events.
Meeting apps feel native when the manifest, context-aware deep links and single sign-on are configured so participants never leave the meeting or face extra prompts.
Subscribing to started, ended and participant events through Graph webhooks lets the meeting itself trigger data syncs, side panel refreshes and follow-up tasks.
hook: Teams meetings are often treated as video calls, while the real work happens in other tabs and after the call. This episode shows Teams developers and solution architects how custom meeting apps, side panels and Microsoft Graph lifecycle events combine into a meeting that brings live data in and hands follow-up work off automatically.
